_comment: Thresholds are set just above what the site actually measures, to catch NEW regressions.
Ratchet them DOWN as the site improves; never up.
2026-08-30: hero videos were re-encoded (95 MB -> 35 MB of .webm) and moved behind
BackgroundVideo.astro, which only attaches the source on large viewports with no
reduced-motion/save-data preference. Lighthouse audits with mobile emulation, so it now
downloads no video at all. Measured totals fell from 5.44-9.98 MB to 0.34-1.48 MB and
homepage performance went 0.68 -> 0.96 locally. total.size ratcheted 12 MB -> 2 MB.
STILL TO RATCHET: categories:performance is left at 0.65 until a real production run
confirms the new score -- local numbers (0.75-0.99) come from localhost with no network
latency and do not transfer directly. document:size and image:size are unchanged because
the video work did not touch HTML or images.
NEXT TARGET: /projects carries ~1.4 MB of images, now the heaviest page by far.
accessibility and seo are NOT ratcheted - the site genuinely passes both at 0.9.
